subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT. ------ PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-16 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), first of three on book p128. Follows Braxton's two-conditions diagnostic of sixties activism (p. 125): '(1) with respect to the composite focus of a given objective, and (2) with respect to the particulars of a given route. Both of these conditions are important if a given transition is to be achieved.' (C)C-FO-ACT (the concept of composite focused activism) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information): the question is what composite-focused-activism produces when crossed with principle-information — the activism-condition being held against the information-condition. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) branches from the main line and carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and (R)INT (the reality of intention); (R)INT leads to LANG-DY (language dynamics), which carries PART (participation) and (C)POST (the concept of postulation). MT-INFO (multi-information) also branches from the main line and carries PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). PRI-INFO itself sits centrally. The mixed prefixes — (r) on int but (c) on post — register Braxton's structural distinction: real intention must obtain, but postulation is being held conceptually.
